name: Anwen
greeting: A moment, hunter. The man behind that screen cannot reach his water.
lines: Anwen: The cup is on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.
Anwen: And that little coat on the bench belongs under the shelf. Oren will complain if I let the rain into his pockets.

variants.greeting: Thank you for the water. He has stopped trying to stand.
lines: Anwen: Would you move that little coat under the shelf? Oren left it here this morning. He said he would be too hot.

variants.greeting: You found a dry place for his coat. Thank you.
lines: Anwen: The man behind the screen needs the cup on the step. Leave it on the linen by his hand, if you would.

actions.label: Tell me about the missing travelers.
I'll help here for a moment. (Optional)
